fontFamilies: Inter Variable, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

aria.snapshot:
- alert
- region "Notifications alt+T"
- separator
- main:
  - text: Ops desk
  - region "Ops desk":
    - navigation "Ops views":
      - button "Inbox"
      - button "Approvals"
      - button "Morning"
    - button "Telegram notifications"
    - button "Refresh"
    - complementary "Proposal queue":
      - heading "Review queue" [level=1]
      - paragraph: Pending first, then recent decisions. Approval alone is not delivery.
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - 'button "Re: Synthetic locale review Task #1 · Run 1 Pending human review"'
        - listitem:
          - 'button "Reply review #6 Task #6 · Run 1 Denied · not sent"'
        - listitem:
          - 'button "Reply review #5 Task #5 · Run 1 Not sent · needs attention"'
        - listitem:
          - 'button "Reply review #4 Task #4 · Run 1 Delivery unconfirmed · do not resend"'
        - listitem:
          - 'button "Reply review #3 Task #3 · Run 1 Sent · provider accepted"'
        - listitem:
          - 'button "Reply review #2 Task #2 · Run 1 Provider accepted · recording pending"'
    - article:
      - paragraph: "Proposal #1 · Task #1 · Run 1 · Support"
      - heading "Pending human review" [level=1]
      - button "Open original thread"
      - paragraph: "Draft #1 · Revision 1. Review all recipients and the complete message below. Edits apply to this approval; the saved draft is not reread for delivery."
      - text: From · inbox identity
      - textbox "From · inbox identity": support@example.com
      - text: To
      - textbox "To": reader@example.com
      - text: Cc
      - textbox "Cc"
      - text: Bcc · hidden from other recipients
      - textbox "Bcc · hidden from other recipients"
      - paragraph: Use plain email addresses, separated by commas. All recipients above are part of the reviewed reply.
      - text: Subject
      - textbox "Subject": "Re: Synthetic locale review"
      - text: Reply message
      - textbox "Reply message": Original approved body
      - group:
        - text: Thread headers · part of the complete payload In-Reply-To · message ID
        - textbox "In-Reply-To · message ID": design-locale@example.com
        - text: References · one message ID per line
        - textbox "References · one message ID per line": design-locale@example.com
      - paragraph: Plain text only. Attachments are not supported in this draft.
      - status: Approving sends this exact reply through Resend. Check To, Cc and Bcc before continuing.
      - button "Approve and send reply"
      - button "Deny proposal"

  - button "New Terminal"
  - button "Hide Terminal (⌘J)"
